content.description: Cross-sectional diagram of fuel injector showing internal components and fuel flow path

content.text: Check operating sound from the each injector.

content.description: Illustration showing use of sound scope to check injector operation

items.text: With the engine running or cranking, use a sound scope to check that there is normal operating noise in proportion to engine rpm.

content.description: Illustration showing manual check of injector by touching with finger

items.text: If you have no sound scope, you can check the injector transmission operation with your finger.

content.text: If no sound or an unusual sound is heard, check the wiring connector, injector, resistor or injection signal from computer.

items.text: Disconnect the wiring connector from the injector.
Using an ohmmeter, check the continuity of both terminals.

content.description: Illustration showing ohmmeter connected to injector terminals for resistance measurement
